Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT Empty & Failure States, photo row · “Photo capture found no patients / unreadable photo | Explicit message; nothing added”. Mixed: stated part — (a) A photo with no residents shows an explicit message and adds nothing; our part — (b)(c) 'Decide later' or closing the sheet writes nothing (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S18 Nothing changes unless the physician confirms: an empty read, 'Decide later', or closing the sheet

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fixture resident In Today; QA Fir (In Today), QA Gum and QA Hazel (not In Today) seeded as in S06

When (a) Scan a page with only a header row → close the sheet. (b) Scan supervisor-mixed.jpg → tap 'Add N to Today's Visits' → on 'Possible duplicate residents' press 'Decide later' → close the scan sheet → Today's Visits. …

Then (a) The app says clearly that no residents were found and adds nothing (Empty & Failure States: 'Explicit message; nothing added'). (b) and (c) Nothing is written: QA Juniper, QA Kestrel and QA Hosp Ivy are not created, QA Gum stays off today, and QA Fir and the fixture resident stay on today

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s18-today-b and s18-today-c contain {snfResident} and QA Fir and none of QA Gum, QA Juniper, QA Kestrel or 'In Today ✓' (a write before the decision would un-mark the fixture resident on main and mark Gum); s18-all contains {snfResident}, QA Fir, QA Gum, QA Hazel and 'In Today ✓' and none of QA Juniper, QA Kestrel, QA Hosp Ivy (U3 'before anything is written'). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S18: 10/10 judged pass — (a) a header-only page read as no rows: the sheet says 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.', offers no Add button, and nothing is added or changed; (b) the mixed photo, 'Add 7 to Today's Visits', the 'Possible duplicate residents' sheet asks about the repeated Juniper row, 'Decide later', close the scan sheet: nothing written (no Juniper / Kestrel / Nursing Home Ivy, Gum still off today, the fixture resident and Fir still on today; backend identical to the start); (c) the mixed photo again, closed at the summary without Add: Today's Visits and All Residents unchanged, backend identical. Whether the empty-read message is clear enough is for a person: 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.' (screenshot tc09-s18-s18-blank.png).
